title: C: Circuit Breaker
description: Implement the Circuit Breaker pattern that prevents repeated calls to a failing operation.

steps.title: Circuit Breaker with Three States
steps.description: Define states: CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN. Implement a circuit breaker that starts CLOSED, transitions to OPEN after 3 failures, tries HALF_OPEN after a reset timeout, and either resets to CLOSED or stays OPEN. Simulate: 2 successes, 3 failures, 1 check.
hints: Use a counter for failures and a bool for state.
